actual_checks: Full exact scientific inputs and metadata read, with zero listed priors. The contribution makes two distinct substantial statements: strongly fillable pairs have zero integral Giroux torsion, and a single underlying T3 has tight structures with unbounded lower bounds. It expressly leaves pointwise finiteness for arbitrary fixed tight structures open.
Gay uses angle pi*t on a length-2n layer; this equals n full turns in the prompt. The filling gluing uses a strongly convex boundary. No weak-fillability conclusion is inferred.

The torus contact forms match the standard tight family after y->-y. Checked the whole closed-layer embedding e_N for 1<=N<n: the z interval has length N/n<1, its boundary tori are distinct, and its pullback is exactly the N-turn form. Thus GT>=n-1, including n=1 giving only the trivial lower bound. Changing n changes the contact structure; no upper bound for arbitrary embeddings is claimed.

scope_and_distinctness.exact_scope: Every strongly symplectically fillable contact 3-manifold has Giroux torsion zero. On the fixed manifold T³, tight structures realize arbitrarily large lower bounds on Giroux torsion. This separates pointwise finiteness from a false uniform bound; it does not establish finiteness for an arbitrary fixed tight structure.
